subject: Admin activity evidence request — export windows, retention, and sample delivery
messages:
From: Audrey Wells <audrey.wells@bluegrove.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:14:00-05:00
Subject: Request: admin activity evidence and export options for upcoming SOC 2 audit

Marcus —

BlueGrove's external audit kicks off next month and the auditors requested an extract of admin activity and operator logs for a rolling 12-month window. Specifically they want to confirm: what events are captured (field-level), exact retention windows, and the available export formats/delivery SLA. 

Could you confirm: 
- Canonical list of admin event types and the fields included (actor, timestamp, resource_id, request_id, ip, outcome, diff payload if applicable).
- Default retention for hosted vs dedicated vs private deployments.
- Ad-hoc export options (NDJSON/CSV), sampling options, how we sign manifests/checksums, and typical turnaround time for a full 12-month snapshot.

If easier, a short sample extract (first 5k events) and a manifest would be great so auditors can validate schema. We can share a secure SFTP or S3 endpoint — security@bluegrove.com is looped.

Thanks,
Audrey Wells
Security & Compliance
BlueGrove Health
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Audrey Wells <audrey.wells@bluegrove.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-08T12:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence and export options for upcoming SOC 2 audit

Hi Audrey —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can support the auditors' requirements; below is a concise summary and a proposed delivery plan. I copied Soojin (ops) and Monica (compliance) to coordinate the extract and manifest signing.

What we log (canonical admin activity & operator trail):
- admin_sign_in: timestamp, user_id, auth_method, source_ip, mfa_status
- api_key_create/delete/rotate: actor, key_id (hashed), timestamp, client_id, reason
- role_assignment/change: actor, target_user, old_role, new_role, timestamp
- config_change: actor, component, change_diff (redacted), timestamp, request_id
- model_deploy/rollback: actor, model_id, version, timestamp, deployment_target
- console_action: UI action id, actor, resource_id, outcome, timestamp
- svc_account_token_issuance/revocation: actor, token_id (hashed), ttl, timestamp
- infra_autoscale_events: pool_id, event_type, capacity_before, capacity_after, timestamp
- data_access_admin_queries (operator-led): actor, query_hash, resource_scope, timestamp

Field-level notes: request_payloads are hashed by default (SHA256) for hosted exports; payload diffs are available in Dedicated/Private on request with redaction controls. All events include a monotonically increasing sequence id and request_id for cross-correlation.

Retention policy (default & options):
- Hosted (Redwood-managed): admin/operator activity retained 365 days by default.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): configurable retention up to 7 years with paid retention add-on and legal-hold support.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): retention is customer-controlled; we provide tooling and manifests, you control retention.

Export options & SLAs:
- Small ad-hoc sample (up to 10k events): delivered within 48 hours as gzipped NDJSON or CSV.
- Full 12-month snapshot (hosted): typical turnaround 3–5 business days; involves bulk snapshot, HMAC-signed manifest, and presigned S3 URL (or SFTP on request).
- Dedicated: streaming options (Kafka connector) or direct S3 mirror; full snapshots typically 1–3 business days depending on volume and redaction rules.
- Manifest and integrity: we provide CSV manifest with SHA256 checksums and a signed HMAC header. For legal requests we can provide attestation metadata (rollup of checksums).
- Sampling options: time-windowed slices, deterministic sampling (1-in-N), or percentage-based sampling; auditors often accept a 1% deterministic sample if scope allows.

Next steps I propose: 
1) We deliver a 5k sample extract + manifest (NDJSON gzip) to your S3 URL for schema validation.
2) If schema accepted, we schedule the full 12-month snapshot and confirm delivery method and SLA.

Would you like the sample to land in your S3 bucket (send presigned upload) or should we provide a presigned download link on our end?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-09T09:30:00-05:00
Subject: Internal: BlueGrove sample extract & manifest (SOC2)

Sooj, Monica —

Audrey at BlueGrove asked for a 12-month admin activity export for a SOC2 audit. I offered a 5k sample within 48h and full snapshot in 3–5 business days for hosted. Can you take the following: 

Sooj: prepare a 5k deterministic sample (NDJSON gz) scoped to admin_sign_in, api_key_* and role_assignment events for 2025-12-01 through 2026-11-30. Redact any request payloads and add request_payload_hash. Add sequence_id and request_id fields. Produce export as sample_admin_events_20261210.ndjson.gz.

Monica: confirm the manifest template (CSV with filename, sha256, event_count, first_ts, last_ts) and append an HMAC signature we can attach. Also confirm whether we need any additional attestation text for BlueGrove's auditors.

I'll coordinate S3 presigned link to the bucket BlueGrove provided in the thread. Flag any blockers.

— Marcus
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence and export options for upcoming SOC 2 audit

Audrey —

Attached is a 5k sample extract and the export manifest for schema validation: sample_admin_events_20261210.ndjson.gz (gzipped NDJSON) and export_manifest_20261210.csv. Delivery details: 

- Sample exported: admin_sign_in, api_key_create, api_key_delete, role_assignment (events between 2025-12-01 and 2026-11-30).
- Manifest columns: filename, sha256, event_count, first_timestamp, last_timestamp. Manifest is HMAC-signed; signature value is in the X-Redwood-HMAC header inside the CSV comment.
- Link (presigned): https://s3.redwood-inference.example/buckets/bluegrove-evidence/2026-12-10/sample_admin_events_20261210.ndjson.gz

If the auditors are happy with the schema, please confirm and we'll schedule the full 12-month snapshot. For the full extract on hosted accounts we expect 3–5 business days from sign-off; Dedicated customers can often be faster depending on connector choice.

Attachments:
- sample_admin_events_20261210.ndjson.gz (attachment) — gzipped NDJSON, 5,000 events
- export_manifest_20261210.csv (attachment) — manifest with SHA256 checksums + HMAC signature

If you prefer an SFTP transfer instead of S3 presigned links let us know and we'll arrange it.

Best regards,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
